description: Mogelijke waterbergingsgebieden is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by downloads.rijkswaterstaatdata.nl. The geodatabase SignalMapWater storagedeepestdelen.gdb contains polygon files of reference areas and 2 grid files that show the location of the 5 to 10 percent deepest parts of the reference areas. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Possible water storage areas" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.nl). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
